headline: Profit rebounds sequentially, but y/y earnings soften
summary_short: Revenue was $1,571.6M, up 1.1% y/y and up 27.5% q/q; EPS of $0.20 rebounded from a $(0.32) loss last quarter but was down from $0.25 a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue rose 1.1% y/y and 27.5% q/q to $1,571.6M. Gross profit was roughly flat y/y at $776.2M but up 29.7% q/q. Operating income fell 12.7% y/y to $81.3M despite a 20.9% q/q rebound. EBITDA was $136.5M, down 2.6% y/y after swinging from a $28.4M q/q loss. Net income of $42.1M was down 20.6% y/y, reversing a $67.1M prior-quarter loss. Diluted EPS was $0.20, versus $0.25 a year ago and a $(0.32) loss last quarter.
